top_signals.title: China Ties 'Bumpy' But Engagement Will Continue, US China Ambassador Says
top_signals.summary: US Ambassador to China David Perdue says Washington seeks to diversify its supply chains rather than fully decouple from Beijing, while adding relations are currently "bumpy" with many areas of disagreement. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Osaka struggles to stamp out cigarette littering
top_signals.summary: Despite a citywide ban on smoking on streets, a deadly fire believed to have been caused by a discarded cigarette butt broke out there last year.
